courses.title: Higher-Dimensional Merge Walk-In Master Class Intensive
courses.description: A two-hour recorded master class, in audio and video, from Aleya's Master Class Series. She describes what she calls walk-ins and higher-dimensional merges, and teaches energetic practices for grounding, rebuilding one's support structures and releasing patterns inherited from a previous soul.
